name: Master Premium Ultra-Thin Stainless Steel & Metal Cut Off Wheels (105mm x 1.0mm)
shortDescription: Ultra-thin 1.0mm reinforced resinoid cut-off disc (105mm x 16mm) running at 15,300 RPM for fast, burr-free, low-heat cutting of stainless steel and rebar.
overview: Master Premium Ultra-Thin cut-off wheels represent the pinnacle of abrasive cutting speed, accuracy, and efficiency for angle grinders. With an ultra-slim 1.0mm cutting kerf, this wheel cuts through solid stainless steel bars, mild steel tubing, angles, and sheet metal with minimum resistance, generating negligible heat and zero thermal discoloration (blueing) on sensitive stainless steel alloys. Built with double-layer high-tensile fiberglass reinforcement mesh, it guarantees outstanding operational safety and burst resistance at rotational speeds up to 15,300 RPM (80 m/s).
keyFeatures: Ultra-thin 1.0mm cutting thickness delivers lightning-fast cutting with minimal material loss
Double-sided high-tensile fiberglass mesh reinforcement prevents wheel shatter and bursting
Specialized calcined aluminium oxide abrasive grains (A60T-BF) provide long service life
Free of iron, sulfur, and chlorine (< 0.1% Fe/S/Cl): will not cause rust on SS 304/316 welds
Produces clean, precise, burr-free cuts that eliminate time-consuming post-weld grinding
Minimal dust, reduced spark shower, and lower mechanical strain on angle grinder motors
Certified to EN 12413 and oSa international abrasive safety standards
applications: Cutting stainless steel (SS 304, 316) pipes, tubes, and architectural sheets
High-speed cutting of mild steel solid rebar, angle iron, and channels
Sheet metal panel cutting in automotive and electrical enclosure fabrication
Trimming stubborn rusted bolts, studs, and padlocks on industrial sites
